description:
"Oh no, I'm surrounded by Kemomimi!"

>> Download v1.5.51-en1 <<
Game version: 0.98a-RC8  |  Nexerelin optional  |  Original Chinese release
Save warning: Not safe to remove. v1.4.0+ is incompatible with saves using v1.3.9 or earlier.
BALANCE WARNING: FoxTwo Ship Pack is a high-power mod. Some of its strongest ships, weapons and officers reach power levels comparable to UAF's more powerful offerings, and can significantly outclass vanilla content.

ABOUT

For more than two hundred years, a decommissioned flagship drifted through hyperspace. Her keel was bent from an old impact, and biome modules bolted to her flanks kept her crew alive. Now the Azure Fluff has come back to the Sector, and she didn't come back alone.

FoxTwo Ship Pack adds a fleet of Kemomimi officers, each with her own skills, story and personality. It also brings the White Foxtail ship line, unique bounties and derelicts, and a colony ship you can fly around the Sector.

Fair warning: the fluff and feathers get everywhere.

FEATURES

Kemomimi Officers
Unique officers, each with her own skill set, portrait and recruitment story
Story quests: Ruruka's duels, Stella's colony plot, Jeanne's story, the mysterious egg, and more
Voiced dialogue for special officers during combat and throughout the campaign
Configurable level and elite-skill caps, plus a Codex entry for every skill

Kemomimi Officers
Reine: Princess  |  Ivy: Inugami  |  Libar: Keeper of the Abyssal Library
Silvia: Princess  |  Janus: Destroyer  |  Nagato: Battleship
Nagato Meta: META Battleship  |  Spetta: Heavy Artillerist  |  Solas: Astrologer
Rem: Unicorn  |  Uriel: Archangel  |  Jeanne: Saint
Anat: Goddess of Love and War  |  Unicorn: Light Carrier  |  Stella: Flower Knight
Ruruka: Magical Girl  |  Shiro  |  Sesame  |  Onslaught-chan  |  Tsumuji

Fleet
35+ ships, from the Pelt anti-air frigate to the Foxclaw artillery battleship and the Mortal Dawn super dreadnought
The White Foxtail line: carriers, torpedo cruisers, a field mothership and a mobile shipyard
Unique hulls from bounties and derelicts, including the Radiance of the White Fox, the Abyssal Library, the Super Blue Lobster and the Stoneslaught
30+ fighter wings: the Will to Break ace interceptor, Albatross loitering munitions, and the Odin and Tiara escort gun drones

Ship Roster

Weapon Roster

Mobile Colony
Azure Fluff: Found a colony aboard this colony megaship and take it anywhere
Dock aboard to refit, repair ships and store cargo, and build the Salvage System or the Planetary Tractor Beam
Colony conditions are influenced by your fleet's strength, built-in industries and animal ranches
A Cryosleeper in the fleet raises colony size and industry limits

Nexerelin Starts
Super Blue Lobster, Adrift Among the Stars and Jingzhao Great Cannon
Kemomimi Siege: a background that starts you surrounded by Kemomimi

Fully Configurable
Almost every number in the mod (hullmod costs, skill values, colony effects, difficulty) can be changed in LunaLib at the top left of the main menu

REQUIREMENTS
Starsector 0.98a-RC8
LazyLib
MagicLib
LunaLib
Nexerelin (optional, for the custom starts)

Translation Permission

I asked the author, EririEX, for permission to translate the mod and share it with the English-speaking community.

AI Use Disclaimer
This translation was made with AI assistance and for a bit of polishing.

CREDITS
EririEX: original mod (狐狐船包), including code, art, writing and design. Original release
wither-pt: text polish on the original
Youchen and other public asset creators: art used in the original mod
MrPossible: English translation, with the author's permission

All original content belongs to its authors. This thread only distributes the English translation.
Spotted a mistranslation, awkward wording or crashes? Let me know in this thread.

discordPostHtml:
The English translation of FoxTwo Ship Pack v1.5.51 is now here for us English speakers!

"Oh no, I'm surrounded by Kemomimi!"

Explore a fleet of Kemomimi officers, powerful warships, unique weapons, special bounties and much more!

✨ Features
  • Kemomimi Officers: Unique characters with individual skills, stories and personalities.
  • 35+ Ships: From frigates and cruisers to massive battleships and super dreadnoughts.
  • 30+ Fighter Wings: Interceptors, drones, loitering munitions and more.
  • Mobile Colony Ship: Take the Azure Fluff across the Sector and establish a colony aboard it.
  • Special Content: Unique bounties, derelicts, quests and optional Nexerelin campaign starts.
  • LunaLib Configuration: Customize many of the mod's gameplay and balance values.
⚠️ Important Information
  • Game Version: Starsector 0.98a-RC8
  • Dependencies: LazyLib, MagicLib and LunaLib
  • Nexerelin: Optional (required for custom campaign starts)
  • Save Compatibility: Not safe to remove. Version 1.4.0+ is incompatible with saves using v1.3.9 or older.
  • Balance: This is a high-power content pack. Some of its strongest ships and equipment approach the power level of UAF's more powerful offerings and can significantly outclass vanilla content.

Forum Thread

Original Chinese Release

The translation was made with AI assistance and additional text polishing, with permission from the original author, EririEX.

Enjoy the fluff, feathers and firepower! 🦊
